basic_details.job_title: Delhi University Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Political Science, University of Delhi (DU), is hiring 2 Research Assistants for its project "Tempering Tibetan Ecology by China and its implications on India". The pay is Rs. 20,000 a month (as per IOE norms), and the post lasts as long as the project. The Institute of Eminence (IOE), University of Delhi, sponsors the project under the Faculty Research Programme Grant of IOE. Only Indian citizens may apply. You need a postgraduate degree (minimum 55%) in a relevant Social Science discipline. To apply, email your CV and relevant documents as one PDF to [email protected] by 29

how_to_apply: Applications go by email only. The notice gives these details:
Prepare one PDF file (maximum 10 MB) with your relevant documents and a recent CV.
Send it so that your CV is submitted by 29 October 2026, the last date.
For queries, the department's telephone numbers are 0091-11-2766-6670 and 2766-7725/1551 (O).
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The application must be one PDF of no more than 10 MB.

Tempering Tibetan Ecology by China and its implications on India
Institute of Eminence (IOE), University of Delhi (Faculty Research Programme Grant of IOE)
Rs. 20,000 per month (as per IOE norms)
By email (single PDF of relevant documents and recent CV)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from eligible Indian citizens. The notice sets these requirements for the Research Assistant post: Essential qualification: Postgraduate degree (minimum 55%) in a relevant Social Science discipline. Preferred: NET / M.Phil. / Ph.D. preferred as per IOE norms. Desirable requirements: Experience in literature review, data handling, qualitative/quantitative methods Familiarity with Ecology Proficiency in MS Office, NVivo, Stata Check the official notification for which disciplines count as a relevant Social Science discipline for this post. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly remuneration for a Research Assistant is Rs. 20,000, as per IOE norms. All positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. Continuation of the position depends on IOE continuing to fund the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DU Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications go by email only. The notice gives these details: Prepare one PDF file (maximum 10 MB) with your relevant documents and a recent CV. Email the PDF to [email protected] . Send it so that your CV is submitted by 29 October 2026, the last date. For queries, the department's telephone numbers are 0091-11-2766-6670 and 2766-7725/1551 (O).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: An interview will be held on 31 October 2026 from 10 AM. It may be offline or online. For the online interview, a Google Meet link will be emailed to shortlisted applicants. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not guarantee selection.
